results.title: That March
results.overview: A Romanian intelligence agent follows a brilliant scientist to Spain, where conspiracies and Russian agents collide. Torn between her mission and her feelings, Anabel faces choices that could change everything.

results.title: The Price to Pay
results.overview: In the competitive landscape of French retail, Audrey Dumont navigates the delicate balance between her sustainable ideals and the relentless demands of corporate ambition.

results.title: Atop Babel's Tower
results.overview: One night, Pérez, a small insomniac rat, wakes up feeling uncomfortable. To find out what's disturbing his sleep, he must descend a towering mattress tower where his commune is sleeping peacefully, unaware of his nocturnal descent.

results.title: House Rules
results.overview: HOUSE RULES is about a game night that spirals into bloody chaos as a group of friends unknowingly play a cursed board game. As the night unfolds, their darkest impulses emerge subconsciously, exposing the ruthless nature of game night and capitalism.

results.title: Rotten Apples
results.overview: When Eddie, a successful but insecure actor, is saddled with his Alzheimer's-stricken father after he’s kicked out of Rotten Apples, a nursing home for emotionally inept old men, he must figure out the fastest way to get rid of him—in time for his life-changing Zoom audition with Darren Aronofsky, a role which could finally get him the Award he has always dreamed of.

results.title: Nyepi
results.overview: Tae-pyeong, Yoon-chae and their friends embark on a journey to Bali, captivated by its mystical landscapes. Their local guide, Nova, explains the significance of the upcoming Nyepi Day — Bali's sacred Day of Silence, when all forms of eating, pleasure, travel and even lights must cease. While exploring the island, Tae-pyeong accidentally breaks a mysterious urn, triggering a series of strange and terrifying events that soon force them to violate the sacred rules of Nyepi Day against their will. As reality warps around them, Tae-pyeong begins to realize that a far more sinister force is at play — one that may not let them leave the island alive.

results.title: The Fabulous Time Machine
results.overview: What if it were possible to travel back in time to dream of other futures? In the hinterlands of Brazil, young girls navigate the delicate transition from childhood to adolescence while grappling with social media, religion, their dreams, and the stories of the women who came before them. By inventing a time machine, they revisit the pasts of their mothers and grandmothers and imagine a future in which they can be free, fulfilled, and in control of their own choices.

results.title: Mango Pachcha
results.overview: Set in Mysuru, a crime drama unfolds across a decade (2001-2011), following a chain of events that builds tension over time. The city's setting plays a key role in reflecting different phases across the years.

results.title: Mek in mek
results.overview: Facing financial trouble, an obscure singer with a talent for impersonation teams up with his friends to perform as a double of pop star Arkadi Dumikyan at private events. Chaos ensues when the real singer discovers someone else is touring under his name.

results.title: First Haunt
results.overview: Claire, a young woman afraid to move on, enters purgatory after being brutally murdered, only to find the unexpected business world of haunting where she's assigned to haunt Will - a struggling writer who just found the inspiration for his new murder mystery novel.

results.title: Awake
results.overview: Based on his writings from a sleepless night in U.S. immigration detention, Mahmoud Khalil reflects on being separated from his family and the fragile promises of democracy, justice, and human dignity.

results.title: Transylvania Tapes
results.overview: In 1997, Romanian actress Silvia Enescu mysteriously disappeared while searching for family property in Transylvania. All she left behind were a collection of home movies: the TRANSYLVANIA TAPES. Now, Silvia's daughter Mara travels from Los Angeles to Romania to discover what happened to her mother. With the help of her cameraman friend Dylan, Mara documents her journey, which takes her from the streets of Bucharest to the medieval town of Sighisoara, deep in the heart of Transylvania. Unearthing the truth about her mother comes at a terrible price, as Mara must escape an ancient family curse.

results.title: Dark Giant
results.overview: Dark Giant is a Supernatural Horror and Psychological Family Drama. It Explores How Greed, Guilt, and Generational Trauma Can Manifest as a Literal Curse, Destroying a Family From the Inside Out

results.title: 2 Big to Rig
results.overview: Captured live over the course of GHOST’s two sold-out shows in Mexico City last year, 2 BIG TO RIG is the definitive document of the band's unforgettable SKELETOUR WORLD TOUR, presented in IMAX® in select locations.  Featuring the only pro-shot footage of Papa V Perpetua and his band of Nameless Ghouls from the phone-free SKELETOUR, 2 BIG TO RIG immerses the audience in the GHOST live ritual, including exclusive behind-the-scenes and backstage access.

results.title: Pooja Meri Jaan
results.overview: After Pooja rejects Aniket’s romantic advances, his subsequent death by suicide leaves her facing accusations. As lawyer and friend Sana investigates the circumstances surrounding the incident, questions of obsession, consent, responsibility and the truth behind Pooja’s relationship with Aniket begin to emerge.
